title: A cause is never guessed: a failure that recorded no phase is not a failed browser command
goal: classify() reads a run that did not pass through one ordered table over facts a caller can demonstrate, first match wins and the last row always matches: the step's recorded phase (bind, act, wait) tells the data from the locator from a product reaching a state, a failure that recorded no phase is never read as a failed browser command, confidence is high or low, and only a high classification hands the next move to a specialist
reproduce: every failing check names the facts it classified -- the status, the stopped step and its phase, whether it ruled, the edge and the locator, the calls outside 2xx and the rest -- the cause, confidence and specialist the contract expects and what came back; the probe imports the subject's own classifier and answers in its own process
